title: Power what’s next: OpenText Business Network at OpenText World 2026
summary: Explore OpenText Business Network at OpenText World 2026 and discover how AI, connected data, and B2B integration can power autonomous operations.
body_markdown:
Join OpenText Business Network at[OpenText World 2026](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/summary-1?_gl=1*nif7gw*_gcl_au*NzEyODYyMTcuMTc4OTM5NTkzMA..*_ga*MTUzMzAzNTg5My4xNzgxNTQ0NDk0*_ga_8LWPJ50ZXY*czE3ODkzOTU5MzAkbzg1JGcxJHQxNzg5Mzk2MDI1JGozMSRsMCRoMTUwMDk4NDc2MA..) as we explore how AI is transforming supply chains, commerce, and digital business ecosystems enabling companies to start their journey towards the autonomous enterprise.


Here at OpenText Business Network, we help companies exchange over 32 billion transactions per year; this represents trillions of pieces of data within these transactions. Overlaying our Business Network with AI and Agentic AI capabilities will allow our clients to unlock the power of this data and automate key business processes like never before.


To power their AI strategy companies must not only have accurate and quality data from across their operations, they must have the digital foundation, or backbone, in place to transport this data from siloed systems to a central data platform. The data platform is where the magic happens! It aggregates data, obtains context, and defines agents that will propagate across the extended enterprise and automate key business processes. The data platform provides the stepping stone needed to introduce autonomous operations.


At OpenText World in Orlando this year we have curated an exciting set of 17 sessions to form our Business Network track. In addition, we have our showcase session that will bring this data to life and demonstrate the potential of AI and how it will transform tomorrow’s business operations.


Whether operating in the manufacturing, retail, consumer goods, energy, pharma or financial services sectors, our clients are exploring the potential of Agentic AI. OpenText World will bring these agents to life to demonstrate how autonomous operations will be defined and built in the near future.


## Explore **AI-powered B2B integration**


OpenText Business Network’s showcase session, *[From Data to Decisions: Building the Digital Foundation for the Agentic Enterprise](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=91767f9e-13fd-429e-b253-c691a3ddb592&shareLink=true)* **,** will explore how companies can convert data into intelligence that can drive decisions to optimize enterprise operations. With the help of key client, analyst and technology partners we will bring our Business Network to life like never before.


We have pulled together an exciting set of sessions for senior executives and users that will not only showcase our latest capabilities but will demonstrate how we are embracing and embedding AI into our solutions today. Here is a selection of sessions from our Business Network track:

- [BN06 – Trading Grid Aviator: AI for the People Who Keep B2B Running](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=72bfe645-db98-4a48-8a9e-ba0ccade6003&shareLink=true)
- [BN08 – Legacy limits your next-gen agility: A strategic roadmap from technical debt to AI-powered supply chains](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=eeb92fa4-13da-4d76-8d70-f3b1ab3c8526&shareLink=true)
